svg.title: V-03. Technical safety architecture (SysML v2 view systemInterconnection)
svg.desc: Interconnection view generated from the SysML v2 model. The comma device E-04 holds the QM partition (E-04b hardware, E-01 SoC processes, E-02 ML models) and the ASIL C safety envelope (E-03a safety layer, E-03b platform firmware, E-04a STM32H7). pandad talks to the platform firmware over SPI (IF-04) and drives the MCU boot pins (IF-04b). Bus 0 and bus 2 run through the E-05 harness relay to the vehicle CAN (IF-01, IF-02) and the Toyota forward camera (IF-03); the radar CAN is bus 1. The MCU drives the relay (IF-10). Display, speaker and the SoC-independent siren reach the driver (IF-07); athena and updates reach the untrusted back end (IF-09); the vehicle supply feeds the device and harness (IF-08). Each block lists the safety mechanisms it performs.
